scope: All 277 public evidence records and 186 public assessments (data/public_evidence_records.json, data/public_assessments.json).
rules: No record is deleted. Records restating the same finding of the same original are folded into one card and counted once; records with different findings stay separate but the original counts once.
A verification status is raised only when the original (or, for identifiers, its PubMed record) was actually obtained and read; the level reached is stated per item.
Lack of evidence is not treated as proof of toxicity. Verdict grades and certainty are not changed in this review; changes are listed as proposals.

before.why: 아욱잎은 다양한 잎채소·야생초 혼합식의 한 구성으로 사용할 수 있다. 아욱은 Malva속 식물이며 전문 육지거북 식물자료는 Malva spp.를 육지거북 급여 가능 식물로 분류한다. 다만 Malva verticillata 자체의 정확한 급여 비율을 정하거나 육지거북에게 먹여 본 정량 시험은 아니다. 따라서 정확히 아욱으로 동정된 깨끗한 잎을 여러 적합한 식물과 섞는 혼합식 재료로 사용한다.
before.applicability_note: Malva속에 관한 전문 육지거북 사육근거를 한국의 아욱(Malva verticillata)에 적용한 판정이다.

after.why: 아욱잎은 다양한 잎채소·야생초 혼합식의 한 구성으로 사용할 수 있다. 다만 이 판정의 근거는 Malva속 전체를 ‘급여 가능’으로 분류한 전문 육지거북 식물자료 1곳(The Tortoise Table)뿐이다. 한국 아욱(Malva verticillata) 자체를 육지거북에게 먹인 기록이나 시험은 확인되지 않았고, 그 자료도 이 종을 따로 언급하지 않는다. 따라서 정확히 아욱으로 동정된 깨끗한 잎을 여러 적합한 식물과 섞는 혼합식 재료로만 사용한다.
after.applicability_note: Malva속 전체에 관한 전문 육지거북 사육자료 1곳을 한국 아욱(Malva verticillata)에 적용한 판정이다. 종 수준의 직접 근거는 없다.

same_source_relations.note: Ceccanti C, Brizzi A, Landi M, Incrocci L, Pardossi A, Guidi L. 2021. Biol Trace Elem Res 199:3553-3561. The record ids di_noia_* and di_gioia_* do not name an author of this paper; the ids are kept because assessments refer to them.

same_source_relations.finding: Both records carry the same text (accepted name Poa pratensis L.; use recorded as animal food).

LC-MS/MS profiling and a validated method quantified pyrrolizidine alkaloids and their N-oxides in Borago officinalis leaves; acetylated forms were among the quantitatively most relevant. The folded record states a subset of this.

Both records describe PA in leaves, flowers and microgreens; sattler_borage_pa_2025 adds sample numbers and EU maximum exceedance. Neither the abstract nor the full text could be obtained (Crossref holds no abstract; the journal is paywalled), so the records are not folded.

One record holds the identification result (29 phenolic compounds in leaves), the other the quantification (total phenolic content 5575.96 mg/100 g DW in leaves). Both stay as cards; the paper counts as one source.

proposals_not_applied.proposal: certainty C -> C-, or decide mallowleaf (Malva verticillata, A / C) and mallow (Malva spp., C / C-) together
proposals_not_applied.reason: Both rest on the same genus-level The Tortoise Table entry (plant=363). There is no species-level evidence for Malva verticillata, and no risk evidence either. A grade or certainty change needs owner approval (also listed in PR #287).
One combined specialist entry and one sentence, shared by both assessments; other single-entry specialist verdicts are C.

proposals_not_applied.proposal: add the source's leaf caution to the limits
proposals_not_applied.reason: The Apple (Tree) entry (plant=23) says older, wilting leaves produce a cyanic compound and that it is wise to keep tortoises from eating fallen leaves. The peach-leaf assessment already carries this caution; the apple-leaf one does not.
